q: 销售额最高的三个商品类目是哪些?
detail: 前 3 名次序与真值一致
sql: SELECT p.category AS 商品类目, ROUND(SUM(o.price), 2) AS 销售额 FROM ecom_fact_order_item o LEFT JOIN ecom_dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 3

q: 帮我看看每个州的客户各贡献了多少销售额
sql: SELECT c.state AS 客户州, ROUND(SUM(o.price), 2) AS 销售额 FROM ecom_fact_order_item o LEFT JOIN ecom_dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state ORDER BY 销售额 DESC LIMIT 50

q: 一共有多少个不同的订单?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS 订单数 FROM ecom_fact_order_item o LIMIT 1

q: 平均每个订单花了多少钱?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS 平均每单金额 FROM ecom_fact_order_item o LIMIT 1

q: 运费总共收了多少?
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.freight_value), 2) AS 运费总额 FROM ecom_fact_order_item o LIMIT 1

q: 哪个类目的东西卖得最贵(平均单价最高)?
detail: 前 1 名次序与真值一致
sql: SELECT p.category AS 类目, ROUND(AVG(o.price), 2) AS 平均单价 FROM ecom_fact_order_item o LEFT JOIN ecom_dim_product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 平均单价 DESC LIMIT 5
